notes.title: The original soundtrack of No Case Should Remain Unsolved is OUT!
notes.content:
[b]The original soundtrack[/b] of No Case Should Remain Unsolved is OUT!

Composer Seongyi Yi who participated in Somi's previous games, "Legal Dungeon," "The Wake: Mourning Father, Mourning Mother" presents [b]two soundtracks[/b] that enrich hidden endings.

[list]
[*] Track 1. < Seowon >  2:34
[*] Track 2. < A Secret for You >  3:16
[/list]
